item.title: Lady Tigers fall at Weston in playoffs opener
item.description: By T. Scott Boatright It came down to getting into an offensive groove — Weston did, and Simsboro didn’t. item.description: By Kyle Roberts RUSTON, La. — It was a night when the shots would just not fall for Ruston as a stingy Ouachita (13-12) defense led to a first-round upset of Lady Bearcats (12-8) Monday 54-42 in the first round of the 2025-26 LHSAA playoffs.
